title: DWG IDBUFFER, LAYER_INDEX, and SPATIAL_INDEX encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local transaction controls for three bounded OBJECTS index codecs across inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage body and each distinct effective string/handle stream; preserve version-specific common handles and entry arrays, plus exact SPATIAL_INDEX raw payload bits; publish only after successful encoding. Convert allocation exceptions to false with no caller-buffer changes.

profiles.IDBUFFER: Generated three-entry object-handle list with common reactors and extension dictionary.
profiles.LAYER_INDEX: Generated two-entry layer-name/index/IDBUFFER-handle list with timestamps and common links.
profiles.SPATIAL_INDEX: Generated timestamps and common links; opaque source payload absent in this authored control.

control.tested_route: Direct encodeDwg exposed through test-only derived probes
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.result: The three allocation sweeps pass all 21 layouts across 253 offsets; both focused CTests passed. The broader local DWG roundtrip was not rerun because its known earlier MATERIAL refusal masks these record checks.

limits: Generated local transaction evidence only; it does not extend index object source or producer support claims.
SPATIAL_INDEX opaque raw payload replay is preserved by the staging wrapper but is not exercised by this locally authored payload-free control.
Whole-document reference closure and independent/native index semantics remain gated.
